topic: iPhone 18 Pro Max Gets a 'Prepare to Ship' Battery Mode
details: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Max battery exceeds 20Wh (the regulatory limit for a single lithium cell on air transport), so Apple built a firmware feature — Prepare to Ship, in Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone — that discharges/caps the battery below 20Wh before the phone can legally be shipped for repair, trade-in, resale, or as a gift.
